heading: Your brand
blocks.intro: The site’s name, accent colour, logo and tab icon, kept in Site Settings.

blocks.heading: Changed by an editor
blocks.body: An editor can change the brand without a developer. It shows on the site once it’s published.

heading: The look
Stays in code
blocks.text: Fonts, colours and type sizes are the site’s own tokens, so a developer restyles a site by swapping a few files.
